cmd: cd /opt/weather-tg && timeout 250 pip3 install -q --break-system-packages pymorphy3 pymorphy3-dicts-ru 2>&1 | tail -2; for f in weather_tg_ai.py weather_tg_issue.py weather_tg_channel.py weather_tg_chart.py; do curl -sf -H "Accept: application/vnd.github.raw" https://api.github.com/repos/ruslan591/weather-_Odessa/contents/scripts/$f -o $f.new && mv $f.new $f; done; python3 -m py_compile weather_tg_ai.py weather_tg_issue.py weather_tg_channel.py weather_tg_chart.py && echo COMPILED_V5; python3 -c "import weather_tg_ai as a; print(a.typos(\"выходить в шапке и перчих\", \"\"), a.typos(\"куртке и перчатках\", \"\"))"; F=/etc/cron.d/weather-tg; sed -i "s|^0 3,4 \(\* \* \* root .*weather_tg_issue.py morning.*\)|6,16,26,36 3,4 \1|; s|^0 18,19 \(\* \* \* root .*weather_tg_issue.py evening.*\)|6,16,26,36 18,19 \1|" $F; grep "issue" $F | cut -d" " -f1-7; echo V5_DONE
